test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 9 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern with water in 12 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill one-fourth of the same cistern with water?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total capacity of the cistern = LCM of 9 and 12 = 36 units.

Combined efficiency of (P + Q) = 36 ÷ 9 = 4 units/hour.

Efficiency of P = 36 ÷ 12 = 3 units/hour.

Efficiency of Q alone = 4 − 3 = 1 unit/hour.

Time taken by Q to fill 1/4 of the cistern = (36 × 1/4) ÷ 1 = 9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 hours.**
